events.name: 3D Month Letters
events.description: You, full length in a soft pastel studio, leaning on a column of giant glossy 3D balloon letters that spell NOVEMBER from top to bottom.

events.name: Christmas PFP
events.description: You, the two of you or your pet in a red Santa hat with falling snow and warm fairy lights: a square Christmas profile picture that still looks exactly like you.

events.name: Convertible Coffee Drive
events.description: You drive an open-top convertible with red leather seats past glass towers: you lift a takeaway coffee, take a sip and talk with your hands, filmed low from the passenger seat.

events.name: Dog Coffee Fail
events.description: Your two pets (or you and your pet) play baristas at a glossy black kitchen counter: one pours the kettle, the little one spoons coffee everywhere, the milk floods the counter, and the big one covers its eyes.

events.name: Last Dance
events.description: You two in the Last Dance trend: leaning into the camera head to head on a grey autumn day, then stepping back across a leafy backyard lawn, joining one hand each, flinging your free arms wide and spinning round each other to "The Last Dance".

events.name: Like JENNIE Dance
events.description: You lead about thirty backup dancers in black through a sharp K-pop-style routine in a bright all-white studio with a glossy floor: a head flick and a point at the camera, a spin together, then the crew drops into a ring around you, seen from above.

events.name: Lonyo Dance
events.description: You lead about thirty adult dancers in grey on a big painted sports court in low golden sun: it opens close on your face looking up into the lens, then the camera shoots straight up and the whole crew bounces, swings and leans in unison around you.

events.name: Stadium Calm Down
events.description: You're the one calm person in a roaring football stadium: you turn your back on the jumping crowd, walk slowly to the camera and press both palms down. Calm down.

events.name: The One Who Knocks
events.description: You're Walter White in the bedroom: "I am the danger", "I am the one who knocks", then one long, silent stare into the camera.
